source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

offlane.quote: Vermis rewards steady rifle fire on one hero. Plant Rally Point for endless ammo so you never stop to reload and every third shot keeps landing.
offlane.issue: overclaim: Rally Point's infinite ammo only lasts while the standard is up, not 'never' reload
offlane.rewrite: Vermis rewards steady rifle fire on one hero. Plant Rally Point in fights for infinite ammo, so a reload doesn't break your string of shots and every third one lands.

carry.quote: Erase Vector into L.I.N.X keeps casts flowing for mana regen and gold. Sacrifice refunds mana when abilities hit heroes.
carry.issue: Aion's gold comes from spell damage to heroes, not from casting itself
carry.rewrite: Erase Vector into L.I.N.X keeps casts flowing for mana regen, and their damage to heroes earns gold. Sacrifice refunds mana when abilities hit heroes.

offlane.quote: Poking heroes with Spear of Nyr keeps Doom running and growing; From the Abyss heals you in fights, and Adaptive Plating adds armor as you take hits.
offlane.issue: misleading: Doom fades unless you keep damaging heroes, so occasional Spear of Nyr poke won't sustain it
offlane.rewrite: Doom grows only while you keep hitting heroes, so follow Spear of Nyr with steady Nyrian Spear attacks in trades; From the Abyss and Adaptive Plating keep you standing.

support.quote: Marrow heals Khaimera from damage to heroes, more when low, so you can stay in front. Ambush onto threats and cast Invigorate to shrug off their stuns.
support.issue: unsupported: SOURCE says Invigorate cleanses debuffs, not that it can be cast while stunned
support.rewrite: Marrow heals Khaimera from damage to heroes, more when low, so you can stay in front. Ambush onto threats and use Invigorate to cleanse their slows.

offlane.quote: Doom grows while you keep damaging heroes, matching Akeron's long brawls toward Awakened through Pact of the Devourer. Adaptive Plating adds armor as you take hits.
offlane.issue: garbled clause: 'matching ... toward Awakened through' does not parse
offlane.rewrite: Doom grows while you keep damaging heroes, which suits long brawls where Pact of the Devourer builds toward Awakened. Adaptive Plating adds armor as you take hits.

offlane.quote: Crushing Maw and the Hellfire fireballs hit often, so Rust stacks in the first seconds of a fight and Akeron gets tougher the longer he stays on a target.
offlane.issue: overclaim: Rust caps at 4 stacks, so armor gain stops growing once maxed
offlane.rewrite: Crushing Maw and the Hellfire fireballs hit often, so Rust stacks in the first seconds of a fight and Akeron gains armor while he stays on that target.

support.quote: March! and Song Of My People healing hand Exarch's attack-speed boost to your allies, so keep the Healing Aura up when your carry starts fighting.
support.issue: unsupported interaction: these grant Health Regeneration, SOURCE does not show regen counts as healing for Exarch
support.rewrite: Exarch boosts allies you heal or shield, but Narbash has no direct heal, only Health Regeneration from Song Of My People and March!, so count on its boost lightly.

midlane.quote: Constant Rupture and Bloodbound casts keep mana flowing and earn gold from hero damage; Runic Focus pays off with Sanguine Banquet's larger mana pool.
midlane.issue: misleading: Runic Focus scales with current mana percent, not pool size
midlane.rewrite: Constant Rupture and Bloodbound casts keep mana flowing and earn gold from hero damage; Runic Focus pays off when you keep your mana bar high.

support.quote: Crippling Dagger and Shadow Dance put you close to enemy heroes, so each cast weakens their damage; with Bioluminescence they also stay revealed for your team.
support.issue: wrong vs kit: Crippling Dagger is a thrown ranged dagger, it does not put Kallari within Pilow's range
support.rewrite: Shadow Dance dives put you close to enemy heroes, so each cast there weakens their damage; with Bioluminescence, heroes you damage also stay revealed for your team.
